original_intent: Move the Buildkite workflow compatibility fixes out of release PR #1353 into a dedicated PR from master, including the release plan and the merge-to-master docs and release failures.
derived_intent: Keep GitHub Actions workflow files as the source of truth while making imported Buildkite push and pull-request paths use supported runtime primitives, and restore PR #1353 to its original release-only delta.
destination: new dedicated Buildkite workflow compatibility PR
active_boundaries: Only .github workflow compatibility and required governed proof artifacts; no native Buildkite pipeline rewrite.
evidence: Container validation passed with 201 checks and zero failures after applying the dedicated compatibility changes. Hosted Buildkite proof remains pending publication of this branch.

PR #1350 merge commit 25313da2 exposed Deploy Docs / build (push) and Release / release-publish (push) failures in Buildkite. The docs branch used buildkite-agent artifact upload directly; the release branch did not statically request the scoped GitHub token or registry secret. PR #1353 Release / plan also remained red because runtime shell expansion was embedded in the imported workflow command. The dedicated branch replaces only those adapter-sensitive paths.
validation epoch ve_42fe40ccc39534a4 completed with zero failures
unresolved_assumptions: The Buildkite pipeline has a CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN secret available to the release job; the workflow now declares it so missing access is surfaced by the adapter rather than silently producing an empty environment.
